_note: No wheel: sqlite3 is part of the browser's Python. The boot snippet writes the 24,576-byte sweigartcats.db of the book's online materials (SHA-256 41f0d0b5bc2ebf3835d5b8c59567626bd526038f9733eb57b6759cd05aafcdf9) to the temporary folder under the name the research scripts use, and puts it back before each program if a program removed or changed it. Version 9.96.0 (over 1.0.0): the boot program also collects garbage before every program and, through _restore wrapped once from _before_run, after every program, so that sqlite3 connections left alive in reference cycles by one program neither keep the shared in-memory database alive nor emit a ResourceWarning into the next program.
